# JSON Byte

> JSON Byte is a free, privacy-focused web application for visualizing, exploring, editing, and comparing JSON and YAML documents. Processing happens locally in the browser.

## Primary pages

- [JSON/YAML Visualizer](https://json-byte.pages.dev/): Edit JSON or YAML alongside an interactive graph. Search nodes, navigate with JSONPath or jq paths, collapse branches, inspect and edit source data, and share supported visualizations.
- [JSON/YAML Diff Viewer](https://json-byte.pages.dev/diff/): Compare two JSON or YAML documents with syntax-aware formatting, configurable context, and changed-line filtering.

## Key capabilities

- Parse JSON, JSON with comments, YAML, and multi-document YAML.
- Visualize objects and arrays as an interactive node-and-edge graph.
- Keep the Monaco text editor and graph representation synchronized.
- Search by content, JSONPath, or jq path.
- Inspect and edit a selected node's source data.
- Import local files or fetch JSON from a URL.
- Export shareable links for supported graph sizes.
- Compare JSON or YAML documents side by side.
- Run document processing locally in the browser without uploading document contents to a server.
